verdict.rationale: Synctera exposes distinct transaction guides (domestic wires, internal transfers, external account linking via Plaid/Finicity, RDC) and a webhook API for event data, suggesting a structured transaction model, but no evidence explicitly documents counterparty detail fields, rail-specific metadata schemas, stable transaction identifiers, or enrichment logic that would make raw feeds directly usable in-product. missing for 10: explicit transaction object schema showing counterparty fields, rail metadata, stable IDs, and enrichment/categorization documentation.
